Here are solid hotel options in Williamson County (Franklin + Brentwood) that can handle a very affordable summit for 100, with a main conference room, breakout rooms, and an on site bar or lounge.

## Most budget friendly bets (usually easiest to negotiate)
**SpringHill Suites by Marriott Franklin Cool Springs (Franklin)**  
- 4 event rooms, largest room capacity listed at 350, so 100 is comfortable citeturn3search13  
- On site “The Library” bar and eatery inside the hotel citeturn0search1  
- Good “summit” layout because you can run a main room plus breakouts

**SpringHill Suites by Marriott Nashville Brentwood (Brentwood)**  
- Largest space capacity listed at 280, plus 3 breakout rooms citeturn0search15  
- Lobby bar (eSSSence BAR) on site citeturn2search5  

**Hilton Garden Inn Nashville Brentwood (Brentwood)**  
- 2 meeting rooms, about 1,860 sq ft total event space citeturn1search2  
- Has an on site lounge bar citeturn1search14  
- Works well if your “breakouts” are small or you only need 1 to 2 breakouts

## Mid range, still workable for “affordable” with the right deal
**AC Hotel Nashville Brentwood (Brentwood)**  
- Capacity largest space listed at 100, with 5 breakout rooms citeturn0search2  
- Has AC Lounge (crafted cocktails) citeturn2search0  
- This is a great fit if 100 is your true cap and you want multiple breakouts

**Hilton Franklin Cool Springs (Franklin)**  
- 7 meeting rooms, 6,251 sq ft total event space citeturn3search3  
- Härth Lounge on site with drinks citeturn3search18  
- Bigger hotel often means more flexibility on room setups and flow

## Bigger “conference hotel” options (can be affordable off peak, but usually higher)
**Franklin Marriott Cool Springs (Franklin)**  
- 23 event rooms and lots of breakout capacity citeturn3search2  
- Full bar with live music noted by the local tourism site citeturn2search22  
- Great if you want a more elevated feel or expect to grow past 100

## Quick tips to keep it affordable (what to ask sales for)
- Ask for a **day meeting package** or **nonprofit / education rate** (if applicable)  
- Ask if they will **waive the room rental** with a modest food and beverage minimum  
- Pricing is usually better **Sun to Thu**, and in the **morning to mid afternoon** window  
- Tell them you need: **theater or classroom for 100 + 2 to 5 breakouts + cash bar after**

If you tell me your ideal area (Franklin Cool Springs vs Brentwood) and whether you need 2, 3, or 5 breakout rooms, I will narrow this to the top 3 and give you a simple outreach script to send to each hotel sales team.
